title: Ghost Setlist
description: Tonight's setlist as neon tube lettering riding an S-curve along a dark wall. Flick through it and every song leaves cooling outline afterimages behind it like a long exposure, then lands solid and warm, glowing on the wall and in the glossy floor.
intent: One kinetic type mechanic finished to the edge: a title on a path whose speed is drawn as long-exposure neon ghosts, collapsing into a single lit tube when it settles.
